grammar.purpose: Identify whether an exception or addition is intended
grammar.explanation: 除了 introduces a noun phrase or activity. Its interpretation depends on the following clause: 除了我，大家都来 excludes me; 除了看节目，我还听广播 adds an activity. 以外 can follow the phrase. The same 除了 phrase without its continuation does not decide the meaning by itself.

examples.py: chú le wǒ , dà jiā dōu lái le .

examples.zh: 除了看节目，我还听广播。
examples.py: chú le kàn jié mù , wǒ hái tīng guǎng bō .
examples.en: Besides watching programmes, I also listen to the radio.

examples.zh: 除了周末以外，她晚上也有空。
examples.py: chú le zhōu mò yǐ wài , tā wǎn shang yě yǒu kōng .
examples.en: Besides weekends, she is also free in the evenings.

commonMistakes.wrong: 除了我，大家都来，所以我也来。
commonMistakes.right: 除了我，大家都来，我不来。
commonMistakes.why: In this 都 construction, the named person is excluded.

grammar.pattern: 除了……（以外），还 / 也 / 都……
grammar.purpose: Read the continuation and its scope
grammar.explanation: 还/也 commonly signal addition: 除了电视节目，她也看网上的视频. 都 commonly totals the remaining group after an exception: 除了我，大家都看过. State the remainder rather than treating 都 as a claim about all people everywhere. Do not infer whether another person joins from their preference for a similar activity.

examples.zh: 除了广播，我还看电视节目。
examples.py: chú le guǎng bō , wǒ hái kàn diàn shì jié mù .
examples.en: Besides the radio, I also watch TV programmes.

examples.zh: 除了她以外，我也没看过。
examples.py: chú le tā yǐ wài , wǒ yě méi kàn guò .
examples.en: Besides her, I too have not watched it.

examples.zh: 除了周五，其他几天都可以。
examples.py: chú le zhōu wǔ , qí tā jǐ tiān dōu kě yǐ .
examples.en: Any of the other days works, except Friday.

commonMistakes.wrong: 除了我，大家都看过，所以所有人都看过。
commonMistakes.why: The total applies to the remaining group, not the excluded member.

dialogue.purpose: Find who has not watched and what else the host listens to.

lines.zh: 除了我，大家都看过这个节目吗？
lines.py: chú le wǒ , dà jiā dōu kàn guò zhè gè jié mù ma ?
lines.en: Has everyone except me watched this programme?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，除了你，我也没看过。
lines.py: bù shì , chú le nǐ , wǒ yě méi kàn guò .
lines.en: No; besides you, I have not watched it either.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那今晚一起观看吧，电视台六点播出。
lines.py: nà jīn wǎn yì qǐ guān kàn ba , diàn shì tái liù diǎn bō chū .
lines.en: Then watch it together tonight; the TV station broadcasts it at six.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我除了收看电视，还收听电台的广播。
lines.py: wǒ chú le shōu kàn diàn shì , hái shōu tīng diàn tái de guǎng bō .
lines.en: Besides watching TV, I listen to the radio station’s broadcasts too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 观众和听众有什么区别？
lines.py: guān zhòng hé tīng zhòng yǒu shén me qū bié ?
lines.en: What is the difference between viewers and listeners?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这里一个看画面，一个主要听声音，不能说所有媒体都相同。
lines.py: zhè lǐ yī gè kàn huà miàn , yī gè zhǔ yào tīng shēng yīn , bù néng shuō suǒ yǒu méi tǐ dōu xiāng tóng .
lines.en: Here one watches pictures and the other mainly listens; we cannot say all media are the same.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 互联网也能看，大家都来线下吗？
lines.py: hù lián wǎng yě néng kàn , dà jiā dōu lái xiàn xià ma ?
lines.en: It can also be watched online; is everyone joining in person?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 除了周五以外，其他几天都可以，先问每个人。
lines.py: chú le zhōu wǔ yǐ wài , qí tā jǐ tiān dōu kě yǐ , xiān wèn měi gè rén .
lines.en: Apart from Friday, the other days work; ask everyone first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.en: Two groups organize a viewing event jointly for a broad audience.

lines.en: Besides television programmes, they introduce radio broadcasts, offering listeners choices too.

lines.en: Some watch pictures, others listen to sound; the Internet offers another way to join.

lines.zh: 国内和全球都有不同媒体，世界不只有一种节目，类似的节目也可能具有不同特色。
lines.py: guó nèi hé quán qiú dōu yǒu bù tóng méi tǐ , shì jiè bù zhǐ yǒu yī zhǒng jié mù , lèi sì de jié mù yě kě néng jù yǒu bù tóng tè sè .
lines.en: There are varied media domestically and globally; the world has more than one kind of programme, and similar programmes can have different distinctive features.

lines.zh: 哪一类爱好普遍，要说明调查范围，不能从全场都笑推断所有人都同意。
lines.py: nǎ yī lèi ài hào pǔ biàn , yào shuō míng diào chá fàn wéi , bù néng cóng quán chǎng dōu xiào tuī duàn suǒ yǒu rén dōu tóng yì .
lines.en: Claims about a common kind of hobby need a stated survey scope; the whole audience laughing does not establish universal agreement.

lines.zh: 一部讲人生的故事不是每个人的经历，节目和现实要区分。
lines.py: yī bù jiǎng rén shēng de gù shì bù shì měi gè rén de jīng lì , jié mù hé xiàn shí yào qū fēn .
lines.en: A story about a life is not everyone’s experience; distinguish the programme from reality.

lines.zh: 这次除了周五，其他几天都可以，但具体时间还没统一。
lines.py: zhè cì chú le zhōu wǔ , qí tā jǐ tiān dōu kě yǐ , dàn jù tǐ shí jiān hái méi tǒng yī .
lines.en: For this occasion, all days except Friday work, but the exact time is unsettled.

lines.zh: 把区别说清楚，再问朋友想看还是想听。
lines.py: bǎ qū bié shuō qīng chǔ , zài wèn péng you xiǎng kàn hái shi xiǎng tīng .
lines.en: Explain the differences, then ask whether the friends want to watch or listen.

pragmatics.note: Do not speak for all viewers.

conversation.title: Everyone except me?
conversation.context: Discuss exceptions without losing the group's meaning.
conversation.goal: Distinguish excluding one member from adding another activity

examples: 除了周五，其他几天都可以。

notes: AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三28, 三38.
